messages:
Alex M.: quick sync — we need to finalize how dashboards will surface runtime + infra metrics for the new 'service health' and 'cost breakdown' onboarding. thinking out loud: tagging metrics with sensitivity and having dashboard-level visibility rules. anyone opposed?
Maria P.: +1. product needs two outputs: internal ops dashboards and sanitized customer views for support/enterprise reporting. UX question: when a dashboard mixes both, do we auto-generate a sanitized copy or hide panels?
Elaine R.: runtime can add an "access_class" label to emitted metrics (examples: public, customer, internal). that lets the dashboard engine filter at render-time. small caveat: KV-cache hit rate sometimes exposes model internals — tag as internal by default.
Kevin S.: security: need RBAC mapping + immutable audit trail of share actions. also retention policy for audit logs (GDPR/sensitive metrics). can you list what metrics are likely "internal" vs "public"?
Sam T.: from SRE POV: p99 latency by model variant -> internal; token throughput aggregated -> customer OK; per-customer quota breach events -> customer+ops (but maybe redacted); GPU mem trends -> internal. also recommend we store "share" events in the audit table: {user, time, dashboard_id, to_team, to_customer, panels_shared}.
Maria P.: UX: prefer auto-generate a sanitized export for customers (strip/hide internal panels) + allow product to request a sanitized share link. admins can opt to copy full dashboard. DevEx should expose a share flow: who can share, scopes, preview.
Alex M.: proposal: dashboard metadata gets a sensitivity map and a share API. metadata example:
```json
{"dashboard_meta": {"id":"db-178","sensitivity":"mixed","panels": [{"id":"p1","sensitivity":"public"},{"id":"p2","sensitivity":"internal"}]}}
```
Elaine R.: runtime/infra needs to send these labels too. we can add a small shim in the metric pipeline to translate metric names -> access_class based on a maintained ruleset. low overhead.
Kevin S.: RBAC sketch (for review):
```
roles:
  viewer: [public]
  customer_viewer: [public, customer]
  support: [public, customer]
  infra_admin: [public, customer, internal]
```
plus: all share actions write to audit.log with signature and optional justification.
Sam T.: also add a retention tag on dashboards so compliance can auto-archive snapshots for audits. retention TTL and export-of-records endpoint.
Maria P.: can we show a small badge on panels that are internal so product knows while composing? e.g., a pill: "internal-only" with hover text.
Alex M.: yep — small design: pill + tooltip + link to rule that set the sensitivity. DevEx-Bot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/doc/sensitivity (auto-posted doc draft) :memo:
Elaine R.: next steps from runtime side: 1) add access_class labels for the listed metrics, 2) expose endpoint /metrics-metadata to query sensitivity rules, 3) emit examples for infra team to validate. ETA: end of sprint.
Kevin S.: security actions: define audit retention policy + who can escalate data deletion requests. I’ll draft a short policy doc and tag legal.
Sam T.: engineering tasks: dashboard engine needs to support on-the-fly panel filtering, sanitized snapshot export, and logs for share events. I can prototype the filtered render this week.
Maria P.: product: create a template for sanitized customer reports (which panels, wording). will sync with design.
Alex M.: summary action items: runtime: add labels + /metrics-metadata (Elaine). dashboard engine: filtering + sanitized export + audit logging (Sam). security/legal: retention + escalation (Kevin). product/UX: sanitized template + badges (Maria). I'll open a tracking RFC and link owners. thanks all :thumbsup:
DevEx-Bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-08-dashboard-sensitivity (status: draft)
